content: {"reasoning": "Prior authorization is required for CPT 93229 and is missing, and silverbridge offers neither a retroactive auth window nor peer-to-peer review, so requesting either would violate published rules. Submitting (with or without records) would knowingly generate an authorization denial, and appeal/provide_requested_info require a payer response that doesn't exist yet; correcting data is pointless since COB order and coding are already valid. Billing the patient beyond their contractual share is improper and writing off a $563.58 balance with 162 days of filing time left is premature. No available mechanical action can properly progress this claim, so it needs human judgment on obtaining/documenting the missing authorization.", "action": "escalate"}
